study_name: Phase 22 H1 R3 End-to-End Behavioral Utility & Gate 2 Recovery Study
operational_meaning: Empirical evaluation confirms that candidate R3 (S + ternary direction) provides behavioral differentiation on matched-magnitude discordant pairs that are collapsed by the scalar measurement under the evaluated research-harness consumer (differentiating 79.89% of previously collapsed discordant pairs), without causing policy chatter or runaway clarification. This evidence is sufficient to update the draft ADR-029 Evidence Ledger. CRITICAL: The Production Architecture Gate remains STRICTLY LOCKED. Production integration is NOT authorized.
